title: Norm-Governed Multi-Agent Decision-Making in Simulator-Coupled Environments: The Reinsurance Constrained Multi-Agent Simulation Process (R–CMASP)
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'norm-governed' decision-making and 'normative reasoning,' specifically implementing and benchmarking a framework for obligations, permissions, and prohibitions (deontic logic) within a multi-agent system. It also extensively deals with 'epistemic' roles and logic, which are components of epistemology.
